primary_route: Calibrated forced reverse gamma rotation in isolated F1 with ADP/phosphate and direct ATP measurement; motion, direction, enzyme and analytical controls.

checks.quote: # Mechanistic Question and Experimental Design: Testing Reversible Mechanochemical Coupling in F1-ATPase
checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution consultation of primary Methods, supplements or validated mechanical-manipulation/ATP-assay protocols with verification of transfer to this system.

checks.quote: No (buffer only)
checks.reason: Combined ADP-plus-phosphate omission does not independently establish phosphate requirement or exclude ADP-only ATP-generating contamination; the required distinct substrate counterfactuals are not implemented.

checks.quote: From known bead geometry, viscous drag coefficient, and rotation speed, estimate applied torque.
checks.reason: Hydrodynamic drag torque is a dissipative component, not the total actuator torque transmitted against the enzyme. Substituting a published stall torque does not calibrate actual work delivered in this preparation.

checks.quote: Integrate bioluminescence signal above baseline
checks.reason: Static intensity-versus-ATP calibration does not convert an intensity slope or integral into ATP production under a consuming luciferase reporter. Kinetic consumption is acknowledged later but not incorporated. Also, absolute handedness is asserted without an empirical direction/optical-inversion calibration.
